in_greek.name: Κλέμεντος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word κλεος (kleos) meaning glory or renown, and the suffix -μεντος (mentos) meaning one who has, indicating someone who has or brings glory, renown, or mercy.

in_latin.name: Clemens
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word clemens, meaning mild, merciful, or compassionate.
